about_the_game:
Unlock the secrets of the legendary Commandos!

Gain top-level clearance and delve into the history of Commandos: Origins. The ‘Classified Archives’ is a comprehensive digital lore book, packed to the brim with stories, background info, and tactical dossiers granting you exclusive intel into the latest installment of the legendary real-time tactics series.

In collaboration with publishing house BILDNER Verlag, we’ve declassified the Commandos archive to give you full access to its rich history. Compiled with military precision, this in-depth PDF is crafted with a passion for detail, offers insider knowledge, historical context, and additional behind-the-scenes insights - inspired by military intelligence reports.

Inside the Archives, you will find:

  • The History of Commandos: A deep dive into the origins and evolution of the pioneering Commandos series.

  • The Commandos: Detailed character dossiers on each of the elite soldiers that play a role in the series, exploring their backgrounds, skills, and wartime experiences.

  • Weapons & Equipment: A comprehensive look at the tools of the trade, from silent knives to explosive charges, including their historical counterparts.

  • Mission Intel: An overview of the missions of Commandos: Origins and details about the real-world operations that inspired them.

How to access the ‘Classified Archives’ PDF after your purchase:

After downloading the DLC, you can find your Classified Archives PDF in your Steam Apps game folder: \steamapps\common\Commandos Origins\ClassifiedArchives

Alternatively, you can access this folder from the properties of the game in your library, choose "local files", then "browse".

content_descriptors.notes: This Game may contain content not appropriate for all ages: Violence, Alcohol and Tobacco references
